data.title: Summer research programme – return participation form
data.summary: The Global Muster Research Institute confirmed your place in its summer research programme. You must return the signed participation form by 7 August 2026 (the date is written 07/08/2026).
data.explanation: The institute's International Study Office has confirmed your place in the summer research programme. To keep it, sign the participation form and send it back to them. The letter says forms received after the deadline cannot be considered, so you could lose your place if you are late. The date is printed as 07/08/2026, which could mean 7 August or 8 July. I read it as 7 August, the usual German order, so check with the office if you are unsure. No payment is requested.
